price.event_timestamp: Kline open and close times are exchange-event fields; a 1d bar is complete only after its close time.
price.exchange_timestamp: Present in the official Kline schema.
price.publication_timestamp: The official project says daily archives become available the next day, but supplies no per-object first-publication timestamp or proof of availability by the frozen 00:05 UTC deadline.
price.collection_timestamp: No historical project collection receipt is preserved; the local dataset was collected in 2026.
price.archive_timestamp: Only current archive identity and current immutable local snapshots are bound.
price.revision_lineage: The official project states archived files may be replaced and lists some replacements, but the current Price V1 bytes do not preserve a complete object-level vintage chain proving which bytes were available at each historical decision.
price.future_fill_policy: FORBIDDEN; missing bars cannot be repaired with later bytes for admission
price.reason: Current checksums and completed-bar semantics do not prove historical first availability or the as-of bytes used at each frozen decision.

funding.event_timestamp: Official API defines fundingTime and the local archive contains ordered funding event times and actual rates.
funding.exchange_timestamp: Funding event time is available; it is not a publication or arrival timestamp.
funding.publication_timestamp: No historical per-event publication or arrival timestamp is preserved.
funding.collection_timestamp: No historical project collection receipt is preserved; local files are current-retrieval evidence.
funding.archive_timestamp: The monthly archive identity is bound through the shared acquisition manifest, not through historical first-publication records.
funding.revision_lineage: No project-bound event-level revision/vintage lineage proves the rate bytes visible before each frozen decision.
funding.cash_flow_semantics: Rate alone is not literal cash flow; direction, position notional, timing, and contract-unit accounting are mandatory.
funding.reason: Current 2726-object coverage does not prove that each funding event was published and unchanged by the historical decision cutoff.

open_interest.event_timestamp: The official API defines timestamp as the period end; local daily metrics rows expose observation/create time.
open_interest.exchange_timestamp: The exact 23:55 UTC observation is the required endpoint.
open_interest.publication_timestamp: No historical per-endpoint publication timestamp is preserved.
open_interest.collection_timestamp: No historical project arrival receipt is preserved; current local file timestamps are 2026 receipts.
open_interest.archive_timestamp: Current Data Vision object identity and checksum only.
open_interest.revision_lineage: No endpoint-level first-availability or revision/vintage chain is preserved; the REST endpoint currently exposes only the latest one month.
open_interest.required_endpoint_policy: Exactly 31 positive endpoints at 23:55 UTC for t-30 through t; 288/288 intraday rows are diagnostic only; any defect invalidates the entire scheduled rebalance.
open_interest.reason: The existing source was built for an older monthly 30-name scope, never covers more than 25 fixed-cohort names in a selection month, omits 40 cohort symbols entirely, and lacks historical arrival/revision evidence.

signal_availability.reason: No family proves publication or arrival by t+1 00:05 UTC; observation/event timestamps cannot substitute for arrival.

symbol_identity.reason: The 80 records bind exact Binance USD-M perpetual symbols, venue, quote/margin asset, and frozen lifecycle intervals; AKROUSDT is outside the cohort. This does not prove numeric vintage or complete contract-specification lineage.

coverage.reason: OI scope never reaches the frozen 30-name floor for the fixed cohort and all numeric families fail vintage.

cost_model_input_availability.reason: The baseline is explicitly PLACEHOLDER_UNVERIFIED except for a current account fee observation; no historically bound executable quote/trade, spread/slippage, fee schedule, complete contract multiplier, or replayable funding cash-flow dataset is bound.

lookahead_status.reason: The frozen contract delays decision and execution and forbids completed post-execution bars, but the data cannot prove timely arrival, so schedules fail closed rather than using future bytes.

official_evidence.supports: Daily archives become available the next day; CHECKSUM files verify current integrity; archived files may later be updated.
The current official update directory is a limited archive-replacement ledger, not per-object first-publication or full vintage storage for the required bytes.
Kline open/close fields, fundingTime, OI period-end timestamp, and the current OI history endpoint's latest-one-month limit.

process_integrity.effect_on_decision: NONE; the contract was already frozen, no Candidate B performance exists or was accessed, and no field, threshold, cohort, window, or symbol rule was changed from performance.
